frozen_for: round 7 · WS-T · step A — candidate policy and bound, before any application
invariant: TRUST = SERVED ∩ admit(...). Activation cannot serve one new block.

served_only.reason: trusted ⊆ served. Activation may not serve one block that is withheld today.
served_only.evidence: ROUND6 §3 «the served set is byte-identical before and after, in every population».

no_repair.reason: A repaired, restored or validated-repaired block is never trusted by this policy.
no_repair.evidence: ROUND5 doctrine; ROUND6 §3 — 9 validated repairs crossed the pipeline, trusted: 0.

two_stack_exact.reason: Both OCR stacks must agree character-exactly, with no tone disagreement. NECESSARY, NEVER SUFFICIENT — agreement does not imply truth.
two_stack_exact.evidence: ROUND4 falsified OCR_A==OCR_B => TRUE. A3 §3: adding this floor to today's guards moves 26 wrong served to 22, i.e. it removes some wrong blocks and no more than some.

role_known.reason: Refuse a block whose role the role layer could not determine (confidence 0.60 is the `body` fallback, i.e. «we could not tell»).
role_known.evidence: A3 §4 «role confidence is a step function, not a dial»; the 0.60→0.70 step removes 84 served blocks. MEASURED CONSEQUENCE: it removes ALL continuous prose.

role_not_teaching_shaped.reason: Refuse the roles whose errors are teaching-critical BY CONSTRUCTION: a question (a non-question served as a question is a teaching error), an option (an incomplete multiple choice is wrong, not merely smaller), an activity, a caption (bound to a figure the child is not shown).
role_not_teaching_shaped.evidence: ROUND5 97-row defect 8 (sibling withholding is itself teaching-critical); gold plane: `as_question` is 6 of 26 wrong served blocks and 6 of 12 teaching-critical ones.

role_not_interactive.reason: Refuse question/option/activity only — prose and captions stay eligible.
role_not_interactive.evidence: The relaxation of `role_not_teaching_shaped` used by candidate C2.

role_is_question_high_confidence.reason: Admit ONLY blocks the role layer calls a question, at role confidence >= 0.90. This is a SECOND gate for a question surface, not a stricter setting of the reading gate.
role_is_question_high_confidence.evidence: TC-19 #3 requires QUESTION precision >= 0.95 before an auto-labelled question is graded. A3 measured trusted-QUESTION precision 0.903 at n=72 — the requirement is NOT MET, and role is the least reproducible class measured (kappa 0.423-0.713).

no_figure_dependence.reason: Refuse a block whose meaning depends on a figure the product does not render.

not_mathematical.reason: Refuse mathematics until a structured formula representation exists. Flattened mathematics is not a fidelity question the gate can answer.
not_mathematical.evidence: A3 §2: `math_guard` is the only guard whose sole-withheld blocks split evenly (4 clean, 4 wrong) — a detector with no discrimination. Round-3 audit: Toán false trust 0.878. ROUND6 §7: 41 fabricated Toán expressions removed; the app ships zero Toán exercises.

order_ok.reason: Refuse a block the verifier says moved.
order_ok.evidence: Gold plane: `order_ok=False` carries wrong 2/14 (0.143) vs 24/340 (0.071). WEAK — reading-order inversion is the LARGEST wrongness class (14 of 26) and this signal does not see most of it.

sibling_complete.reason: Refuse a block if any member of its structural group (OPTION ⊂ QUESTION, a caption bound to its figure, a table row, a step in a procedure) is withheld. Withholding one member must withhold the whole group.
sibling_complete.evidence: ROUND5 97-row defect 8 — a teaching-critical failure produced by the safety mechanism itself. MACHINERY DOES NOT EXIST: no group key is carried on an evidence row.

digit_sequence_verified.reason: If the block contains digits, an INDEPENDENT check must confirm the digit sequence.
digit_sequence_verified.evidence: Gold plane: 6 of 12 teaching-critical served blocks are digit corruptions, and 3 of them survive character-exact two-stack agreement — both stacks agreed on the same wrong digits. No signal a gate can read separates them. MACHINERY DOES NOT EXIST.

candidates.notes: FROZEN AS A CANDIDATE, NOT AS AN OPTION. Both added clauses have no implementation, so this policy cannot be evaluated and `policy.evaluate` marks its numbers MEASUREMENT INVALID. It is here because it names the only work that would move the bound.

BOUND-0.decision_rule: the status quo. No audit, no admission, no claim.
BOUND-0.rationale: ROUND6 graded Gate D a TRUTHFUL ZERO and the Founder accepted it. Keeping it is a legitimate outcome of this calibration, not a failure of it.

BOUND-1.promise: P(a lesson's trusted blocks contain no teaching-critical error) >= 0.95
BOUND-1.decision_rule: PASS iff, on the frozen blind population, the Wilson 95 % UPPER bound on the teaching-critical rate among admitted blocks is <= 0.00171 AND the upper bound on false trust is <= 0.02. Otherwise the result is trusted = 0 and a truthful zero is reported.
BOUND-1.rationale: The strongest promise anyone could state to a parent without qualification: 19 lessons in 20 carry no teaching-critical error.
BOUND-1.prediction_from_pre_existing_evidence: PREDICTED FAIL. The best measured candidate has a teaching-critical rate of 0.0213 on the gold plane; the expected number of such errors in the required audit is ~48, and the rule requires 0.

BOUND-2.promise: P(a lesson's trusted blocks contain no teaching-critical error) >= 0.9
BOUND-2.decision_rule: PASS iff, on the frozen blind population, the Wilson 95 % UPPER bound on the teaching-critical rate among admitted blocks is <= 0.00351 AND the upper bound on false trust is <= 0.05. Otherwise the result is trusted = 0 and a truthful zero is reported.
BOUND-2.rationale: Nine lessons in ten clean. Still a promise that survives being said out loud, and roughly an order of magnitude better than anything measured.
BOUND-2.prediction_from_pre_existing_evidence: PREDICTED FAIL. Expected ~23 teaching-critical errors in the required audit against a rule that permits 0.

BOUND-3.promise: P(a lesson's trusted blocks contain no teaching-critical error) >= 0.8
BOUND-3.decision_rule: PASS iff, on the frozen blind population, the Wilson 95 % UPPER bound on the teaching-critical rate among admitted blocks is <= 0.00741 AND the upper bound on false trust is <= 0.08. Otherwise the result is trusted = 0 and a truthful zero is reported.
BOUND-3.rationale: The weakest lesson-level promise this workstream is willing to write down: one lesson in five carries a teaching-critical error.
BOUND-3.prediction_from_pre_existing_evidence: PREDICTED FAIL. Expected ~11 teaching-critical errors against a rule that permits 0. Even this is ~3x better than measured.

BOUND-4.promise: block-level teaching-critical rate, upper 95 % bound <= 0.02. NO lesson-level promise is implied and none may be quoted.
BOUND-4.decision_rule: PASS iff tc_upper95 <= 0.02 and ft_upper95 <= 0.10 on the blind population. n = 189 with zero observed, 437 with three observed.
BOUND-4.rationale: The only bound on this list the pre-existing evidence does not predict will fail. It is included so the Founder can see what «achievable» costs.
BOUND-4.prediction_from_pre_existing_evidence: BORDERLINE. The measured point estimate is 0.0213 — on the wrong side of the bound by a hair, well inside sampling noise. CONSEQUENCE, stated because the bound hides it: at 0.02 and L=30, 45 % of lessons carry at least one teaching-critical error. This bound is passable and its consequence is not sayable to a parent.

BOUND-5.promise: a lesson is trusted only when EVERY one of its blocks has been verified against the printed page by a human. The bound is per lesson, not per block.
BOUND-5.decision_rule: PASS for a given lesson iff every block in it was verified and none was found wrong. There is no sampling and therefore no confidence interval.
BOUND-5.rationale: NOT A THRESHOLD, and that is precisely why the arithmetic permits it. A threshold spends a measured error rate across content nobody looked at; certification spends human attention and produces no residual rate to bound. ROUND7-PLAN already prefers this shape: «prefer the already-measured Golden lessons. Do not scale to the whole corpus.»
BOUND-5.prediction_from_pre_existing_evidence: ACHIEVABLE for a bounded slice, at ~30 human verifications per lesson. It does not generalise, it does not produce a corpus-level claim, and it must never be described as a trust threshold having been met.

recommendation.statement: Freeze C2 under BOUND-2 and run the blind evaluation expecting it to fail. C2 because it is measurably better than C1 on both axes at once; BOUND-2 because it is derived from a promise about a lesson rather than from what the pipeline happens to achieve, and it is the weakest such promise that is still worth making. The pre-existing evidence predicts a truthful zero, and predicting the outcome before measuring it is what distinguishes a calibration from a selection. If it passes, that is news; if it fails, the round ends exactly where round 6 ended, with one difference: the zero will have been MEASURED against a predeclared bound instead of asserted from the absence of a threshold.
recommendation.what_would_actually_move_it: Not a threshold. All 12 measured teaching-critical errors in the served set fall into exactly two mechanisms — digit corruption (6) and a non-question served as a question (6) — and neither is visible to any signal a gate can read; 3 of the 6 digit corruptions survive character-exact agreement between two independent OCR stacks. An independent digit-sequence check and a question/non-question discriminator would each attack half of the measured harm. A tighter threshold attacks neither.
recommendation.if_a_non_zero_is_required: BOUND-5, per-lesson certification of a bounded slice — every block of one lesson verified against the print by a human, ~30 verifications. It is not a threshold, it produces no corpus claim, and it must never be reported as one.

guard_free_observations.role_confidence_floor_is_not_a_safety_di: raising the floor to 0.70 lowers false trust 0.0734 -> 0.0593 and RAISES the teaching-critical rate 0.0339 -> 0.0407, while removing every block of continuous prose (the `body` role carries the 0.60 «could not tell» confidence).
guard_free_observations.teaching_critical_is_not_a_subset_of_fal: on the gold plane the two sets overlap but neither contains the other; on the audit plane teaching-critical is a strict subset. The two planes do not even agree on the SET RELATION, because they use different definitions of «wrong».
guard_free_observations.no_single_false_trust_number_exists: the same quantity measures between 0.073 and 0.727 across the five populations this repository has annotated. A bound quoted without its plane, pipeline version and population is not a bound.

declared_limitations: The gold plane is 54 DELIBERATELY HARD pages, not a sample (A3 §5.2). No rate in this payload transfers to the corpus, and none is offered as a corpus estimate.

Teaching-critical is defined NARROWLY on the gold plane (corrupted digits, a non-question served as a question). The audit protocol also counts truncation, in-sentence contamination and term-level tone slips. The two are not comparable and are never summed.

Every candidate was derived on evidence rows that ALREADY EXISTED before this round. The 181 rows marked held_out in that file were pooled into A3's published curve, so they are NOT a blind holdout and are not used as one here.

The 97-row independent audit exists in this repository only as a published summary table, not as row-level data. Disjointness of the blind population from it can be argued from book coverage but CANNOT BE PROVEN. Recorded as a known weakness.
Independence between blocks in a lesson is assumed by the bound arithmetic and is optimistic: errors cluster by page and by book.
